name: Cosine Warmup + Divergence-Gated CFG
tagline: Replaces zeroinit's hard skip with a smooth cosine warmup and an adaptive gate driven by std(noise_c-noise_uc)/std(noise_uc).
init_recovers: Approaches standard CFG when warmup and div_gate saturate to 1
diff_from_baseline: Vs CFG/CFG++/zeroinit: replaces zeroinit's binary step skip with a continuous half-cosine warmup, multiplies guidance by an adaptive tanh gate computed from per-step std ratio of the conditional/unconditional residual, then applies Imagen-style rescale and renoises with noise_pred (CFG-style, not noise_uc).

name: Std-Normalized Residual + Power Rescale
tagline: Divides the conditional residual by its std before adding it, then rescales the prediction by the power-φ ratio of the unconditional std.
init_recovers: Reduces toward CFG++ when w·std(r) ≈ |c-uc| and φ=0
diff_from_baseline: Vs CFG++: normalizes the (c-uc) direction by its std before applying guidance and rescales the predicted noise by (σ_uc/σ_pred)^φ instead of an additive Imagen-rescale; keeps CFG++'s noise_uc renoise step. Note: also swaps α_t and α_{t-1} indices, so the tweedie/renoise pair differs from the canonical schedule.

name: Negative-Perp Guidance + 2-Step Warmup
tagline: First two steps use n_c only; thereafter subtracts the perpendicular component of the unconditional onto the conditional with Imagen rescaling.

key_hyperparams.name: warmup_steps
key_hyperparams.role: use only n_c for first K steps

init_recovers: Approaches standard CFG when removing the projection step
diff_from_baseline: Vs CFG/zeroinit: keeps zeroinit's 2-step idea but instead of skipping uses pure conditional noise; afterwards reformulates guidance as n_c minus the unconditional's perpendicular component (projected away from n_c) with Imagen rescaling, and renoises with noise_pred.

name: Tri-Phase Projected Guidance
tagline: Splits sampling into zero-init / mid / tail phases with different scales and decomposes (c-uc) into perpendicular and damped-parallel components.
init_recovers: Approaches CFG++ when parallel_suppress=1 and all phases use w
diff_from_baseline: Vs CFG++/zeroinit: keeps the on-manifold noise_uc renoise but combines a 3-phase guidance schedule (zero / 0.75w / w) with a perpendicular-vs-parallel decomposition where the parallel part is damped by 0.5; followed by Imagen-style σ rescale.

name: Sine-Scheduled Perp-CFG
tagline: Adds the perpendicular component of (n_c - n_{uc}) wrt n_{uc} weighted by a half-sine schedule that vanishes at endpoints.
init_recovers: Reduces to plain CFG-style renoise at i=N/2 when schedule peaks
diff_from_baseline: Vs CFG: replaces (n_c-n_{uc}) with its perpendicular-to-n_{uc} component (Perp-CFG) and modulates guidance by a half-sine schedule that is zero at first/last step; renoise uses noise_pred (CFG-style).
